COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Structured Query Language, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Structured Query Language.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Structured Query Language.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Structured Query Language.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Structured Query Language.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Logic Gates, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Logic Gates.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Gates.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Logic Gates.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Logic Gates.

5. When learning Data Representation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Representation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data Representation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Representation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Representation.

6. When learning Object Oriented Programming Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Object Oriented Programming Concepts.

7. When learning Object Oriented Programming Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.

8. When learning Network Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Network Security.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Network Security.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Security.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Network Security.

9. When learning Relational Database Fundamentals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Relational Database Fundamentals.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Relational Database Fundamentals.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Relational Database Fundamentals.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Relational Database Fundamentals.

10. When learning Binary Arithmetic Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Binary Arithmetic Operations.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Binary Arithmetic Operations.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Binary Arithmetic Operations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Binary Arithmetic Operations.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Network Standards and Protocols and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Network Security and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Object Oriented Programming Concepts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Object Oriented Programming Implementation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
